get.description:
Get a collection of `Direct Debit` objects.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Direct Debit` objects will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

post.summary: Create a new Direct Debit object

201.description: Successfully created a new `Direct Debit` object

202.description: Successfully accepted a new `Direct Debit` object

get.description:
*Get a `Direct Debit` object by ID*.
Only `Direct Debit` object will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_dd_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Direct Debit` object to get

patch.summary: Modify/update an existing Direct Debit object
patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Direct Debit` object identified by ID*.
Only `Direct Debit` object will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_dd_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Direct Debit` object to modify/update

202.description: Successfully accepted the modification of `Direct Debit` object

delete.description:

parameters.name: obj_dd_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Direct Debit` object to modify/update
